top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a specific, traceable invention (magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms) and its realisation at roughly 1e-18, with performance intercompared across independent laboratories and a clean two-name allocation to Katori and Ye; the citation is scoped to the lattice clock itself, which separates it from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is a strong, secure discovery with the right three names, but the pairing mechanism, phase diagram and experimental credit beyond Jarillo-Herrero remain unsettled, so I rank it second, ahead of no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; my Chalmers/WACQT connections concern circuit QED, which is not in any proposal on the slate
